description.default: Show the signed-in employee's time-bound worklife metrics and upcoming HR event timeline. Use for prompts such as 'Show my worklife snapshot', 'What is happening in my worklife this month?', or 'Show my HR timeline'. Do not use for a broad cross-family summary, ranked tasks, or service milestones; use GetMyHRDashboard, GetNextBestActions, or GetEmployeeMilestones. Pass period only when specified.
